name: NCR statutory minimum wage - non-agriculture
specification: Daily minimum wage (8-hour day) for non-agriculture workers in NCR under RTWPB-NCR Wage Order No. NCR-28 (issued 2026-09-07, effective 2026-09-26); legal floor, not a market rate
notes: Legal floor, not a market rate. NWPC summary of regional minimum wages as of 2026-10-06: NCR-28 = P755 non-agri (P718 for agriculture, retail/service of 15 or fewer workers and manufacturing under 10 workers). DOLE news release (dole.gov.ph) confirms P695 to P755 from 2026-09-26. NCR-27 (P755 then P780 from 2027-01-20) is enjoined by RTC Pasig 152 / Navotas 287 and not in force.

name: DPWH prescribed labor rate - construction foreman (NCR)
specification: DPWH Prescribed Labor Rate (PLR) for DUPA/POW/ABC, construction foreman, NCR; loaded rate (includes holiday pay, 13th month, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG)
notes: Government estimate basis (budget ceiling), not a transacted rate. Not computed here.
